cases.input: R1 binds process P and accountable U1 until t; R2 binds the same capability and P with accountable U2 from t.
cases.expect: R1 is transferred with validTo and successorRef; R2 opens without changing capability identity.

cases.input: A system-only binding claims full realization.
cases.expect: Rejected; system-only binding cannot establish full realization.

cases.input: A realization names a WM-ORG-004 position realizer whose required competence and period capacity are held in WM-ACT-001.
cases.expect: Accepted; WM-ACT-001 is a declared CapabilityRealization referent for agent competence and capacity.

cases.input: capacityRef on a system-kind realizer points at a WM-ACT-001 capacityStatement.
cases.expect: Rejected; agent capacity cannot carry non-agent realizer capacity and no non-agent capacity referent is declared.

cases.input: A system-kind realizer binding supplies the required accountablePartyRef naming unit U1 and the binding is labelled full realization.
cases.expect: Rejected; accountablePartyRef is not a realizer and cannot satisfy the non-system realizer test.

cases.input: R1 binds process P as the single realizer with unit U1 as accountable party.
cases.expect: Accepted; the one-realizer rule holds because accountablePartyRef is declared not to be a realizer.

cases.input: One realization record enumerates a process, a team and a system as co-realizers.
cases.expect: Rejected under the declared one-realizer granularity; separate bindings are required.

cases.input: Full realization is asserted with no coverage-claim record naming capability, scope and as-of date.
cases.expect: Rejected; fullness is a claim over the binding set and requires its own bearer record.

cases.input: A system-only binding claims full realization by invoking 'stronger governed evidence'.
cases.expect: Rejected; the escape clause is removed and no evidence grade promotes a system-only binding.

cases.input: evidenceRefs are supplied as bare references with no digest and no criterion linkage.
cases.expect: Rejected; evidence requires digest, digest algorithm and criterion linkage.

cases.input: coverageShare 0.4 is recorded with a basis string but no denominatorRef and no measurement period.
cases.expect: Rejected; a share requires value, basis, denominator and effective period.

cases.input: Three concurrent bindings for one capability declare shares of 0.7, 0.6 and 0.3 against the same denominator.
cases.expect: Rejected; concurrent shares on one denominator must reconcile or carry a declared overlap justification.

cases.input: A capability with no realization rows is reported as zero coverage.
cases.expect: Rejected; the state is unknown absent a scoped completeness assertion.

cases.input: A completeness assertion naming population, scope, as-of date, asserter and method covers the capability's realizer population.
cases.expect: Accepted; within that scope and as-of date absence of bindings reads as unrealized rather than unknown.

cases.input: A target-state binding is recorded with status proposed and no assertionMode.
cases.expect: Rejected; assertionMode actual or scenario is required and proposed is a record-draft state only.

cases.input: A binding with assertionMode scenario is included in an authoritative as-of coverage projection.
cases.expect: Rejected; scenario bindings never feed authoritative actuals.

cases.input: An accountability recording error is fixed by editing accountablePartyRef on the existing R1 record.
cases.expect: Rejected; corrections are new knowledge-time records so that correction stays distinguishable from real-world change.

cases.input: R1.validTo is t1, R2.validFrom is t2 later than t1, successorRef is unset and R1.status remains active.
cases.expect: Rejected; transfer requires successorRef, a terminal R1 status and either contiguity or a declared gap reason.

cases.input: status is ended while validTo is absent.
cases.expect: Rejected; terminal states require validTo.

cases.input: A realizer transfer is recorded with status superseded while a record correction is recorded with status transferred.
cases.expect: Rejected; transferred and superseded are disjoint states with declared triggers.

cases.input: Two realizations of one capability are concurrently active with distinct realizers and declared shares on a common denominator.
cases.expect: Accepted; multiple concurrent realizations of one capability are valid.

cases.input: A system-alone-full-realization case is filed in the BusinessCapability fixture set.
cases.expect: Rejected; realization-side rules are exercised against CapabilityRealization.

cases.input: A fixture expectation reads only 'coverage is evidence-based'.
cases.expect: Rejected; expectations must name observable field-level outcomes.
